223.canonical: Bound the planner–evaluator reasoning loop with an explicit maximum-iteration cap: the evaluator either returns success or routes structured feedback back to the planner, which consumes it to revise the plan.

260.canonical: Treat the spec diff (the docs/specification/draft change) as ground truth for a SEP's normative requirements: read the RFC-2119 sentences yourself rather than trusting the SEP summary or PR description, and flag any table/prose mismatch as a spec gap rather than silently resolving it.

261.canonical: Ship every conformance scenario with both a passing example (run green against a real implementation such as the everything-server or an external SDK) and a negative test that pins the specific failing check slugs it must catch — a green run alone only proves no false positive, and asserting failure-count > 0 does not prove the check works.
